crew.overview: One hot summer day a little girl gets lost in an enchanted forest of the mountain god where spirits reside. A young boy appears before her, but she cannot touch him for fear of making him disappear. And so a wondrous adventure awaits...

details.biography:
Yuki Midorikawa (緑川ゆき, Midorikawa Yuki, born May 23, 1976) is a Japanese manga artist. She is mainly known for her shoujo manga works in the magazines LaLa and LaLa DX, published by Hakusensha.

Her most successful works were Hotarubi no Mori e, which received a film adaptation in 2011, and Natsume's Book of Friends, which was adapted into an anime, with its seventh season released in 2024. The manga has sold over 5 million copies since the release of the 12th volume.
